# Kotlin Coroutine - (current)

> Explore the MongoDB Kotlin Driver for server-side applications using coroutines, including setup, usage examples, and troubleshooting.

- [Aggregation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/aggregation.md): Learn to use aggregation operations in the MongoDB Kotlin driver to process data and return computed results using the aggregation pipeline.
- [Aggregation Expression Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/aggregation/aggregation-expression-operations.md): Learn to use the MongoDB Kotlin Driver for constructing aggregation expressions with typesafe Java methods, enhancing readability and functionality.
- [API Documentation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/api-documentation.md): Explore the API documentation for Kotlin, including BSON serialization, driver extensions, core functionality, and coroutine and sync drivers.
- [Run a MongoDB Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/atlas-search.md): Learn about how to use MongoDB Search in the MongoDB Kotlin Driver, including how to create a Search index, construct a pipeline, and see Search metadata.
- [Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/builders.md): Explore how to use Kotlin driver builder classes for efficient CRUD operations and aggregation, enhancing error detection and code completion in your IDE.
- [Aggregates Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/builders/aggregates.md)
- [Use Builders with Data Classes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/builders/builders-data-classes.md)
- [Filters Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/builders/filters.md)
- [Indexes Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/builders/indexes.md)
- [Projections Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/builders/projections.md)
- [Sorts Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/builders/sort.md)
- [Updates Builders](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/builders/updates.md)
- [Run a Database Command](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/command.md): Learn how to run a database command using the Kotlin coroutine driver.
- [Connect to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/connect.md): Learn how to use the Kotlin driver to connect to MongoDB, including how to create a MongoClient, configure connection settings, and manage connection pools.
- [Connection Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/connect/connection-options.md)
- [Limit Server Execution Time](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/connect/connection-options/csot.md)
- [Compress Network Traffic](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/connect/connection-options/network-compression.md)
- [Customize Server Selection](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/connect/connection-options/server-selection.md)
- [Stable API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/connect/connection-options/stable-api.md): Learn how to enable and configure the Stable API feature in MongoDB to ensure compatibility with specified API versions when connecting to a server.
- [Connection Pools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/connect/connection-pools.md)
- [Choose a Connection Target](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/connect/connection-targets.md): Learn how to connect to different MongoDB deployments with the Kotlin driver, including Atlas, local deployments, and replica sets.
- [Connection Troubleshooting](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/connect/connection-troubleshooting.md): Troubleshoot connection issues with the MongoDB Kotlin Driver by checking connection strings, configuring firewalls, and verifying authentication settings.
- [Create a MongoClient](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/connect/mongoclient.md): Learn how to create a `MongoClient` in Kotlin to connect to a MongoDB deployment using a connection URI and customize connection behavior.
- [Specify MongoClient Settings](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/connect/mongoclientsettings.md)
- [CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud.md)
- [Bulk Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/bulk.md)
- [Compound Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/compound-operations.md)
- [Configure CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/configure.md): Configure Kotlin Driver CRUD operations with read and write concerns, read preferences, retryable reads and writes, collation, and codec options in Kotlin.
- [Delete Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/delete.md)
- [Insert Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/insert.md)
- [Query Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/read-operations.md)

- [Access Data From a Flow](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/read-operations/flow.md)
- [Search Geospatially](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/read-operations/geo.md)
- [Limit the Number of Returned Results](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/read-operations/limit.md)

- [Skip Returned Results](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/read-operations/skip.md)
- [Sort Results](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/read-operations/sort.md)
- [Query Text](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/read-operations/text.md)
- [Replace Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/replace.md)
- [Transactions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/transactions.md)
- [Update Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/crud/update.md)

- [Data Formats](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/data-formats.md)
- [Encode Data with Type Codecs](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/data-formats/codecs.md)
- [Collations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/data-formats/collations.md): Learn how to use collations in MongoDB to order query results by string values, including specifying collations for collections, indexes, and operations.
- [Document Data Format: BSON](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/data-formats/document-data-format-bson.md)
- [Document Data Format: Data Classes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/data-formats/document-data-format-data-class.md)
- [Document Data Format: Extended JSON](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/data-formats/document-data-format-extended-json.md)
- [Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/data-formats/documents.md)
- [Kotlin Serialization](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/data-formats/serialization.md)
- [Time Series Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/data-formats/time-series.md): Learn how to create and query time series collections using the MongoDB Kotlin Driver, including collection options and window functions.
- [Databases and Collections](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/databases-collections.md): Access, create, manage MongoDB databases, and specify read/write concerns with the Kotlin driver.
- [Getting Started with the Kotlin Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/getting-started.md): Learn to connect a Kotlin application to a MongoDB Atlas cluster using the Kotlin driver, including setup, dependencies, and querying sample data.
- [MongoDB Kotlin Driver](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/index.md): Explore the MongoDB Kotlin Driver for server-side applications using coroutines, including setup, usage examples, and troubleshooting.
- [Indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/indexes.md): Learn to create and manage indexes using the MongoDB Kotlin Driver to optimize query performance and support various query types.
- [Third Party Integrations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/integrations.md)
- [Create an API By Using Ktor and MongoDB Atlas](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/integrations/ktor.md)
- [Issues & Help](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/issues-and-help.md): Find support for the Kotlin driver through the MongoDB Community Forums, report issues via Jira, or contribute improvements with pull requests.
- [Logging and Monitoring](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/logging-monitoring.md)
- [Change Streams](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/logging-monitoring/change-streams.md)
- [Logging](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/logging-monitoring/logging.md): Learn how to set up and configure logging in the MongoDB Kotlin driver using SLF4J, including setting log levels and logger names.
- [Monitoring](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/logging-monitoring/monitoring.md): Learn how to set up and configure monitoring in the MongoDB Kotlin driver to track resource usage and performance.
- [Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/reference.md)
- [Migrate from KMongo](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/reference/migrate-kmongo.md): Learn how to migrate your application from KMongo to the official MongoDB Kotlin driver.
- [Release Notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/reference/release-notes.md): Discover the latest features, improvements, and fixes in recent MongoDB Kotlin Driver versions, including new classes and API changes.
- [Upgrade Driver Versions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/reference/upgrade.md): Learn how to upgrade your Kotlin driver to a new version, including how to identify breaking changes and verify compatibility before you upgrade.
- [Security](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/security.md)
- [Authentication Mechanisms](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/security/auth.md): Learn how to authenticate with MongoDB using various mechanisms like SCRAM-SHA-256, MONGODB-AWS, and X.509, and configure connections with Kotlin.
- [Kerberos (GSSAPI) Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/kotlin/coroutine/current/security/auth/kerberos.md)
